Objective/Summary: Verify login with valid mobile number and OTP
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Open app 2. Enter valid mobile number 3. Click Get OTP 4. Enter received OTP 5. Click Login
Expected Output: User logged in successfully

Objective/Summary: Verify OTP is received within 30 seconds
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid mobile number 2. Click Get OTP 3. Note the time OTP is received
Expected Output: OTP should arrive within 30 seconds

Objective/Summary: Verify login fails with incorrect OTP
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid mobile number 2. Enter wrong OTP 3. Click Login
Expected Output: Error: Invalid OTP message should display

Objective/Summary: Verify expired OTP is rejected
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter mobile number 2. Request OTP 3. Wait 10 minutes 4. Enter expired OTP
Expected Output: OTP expired message should display

Objective/Summary: Verify account locked after 5 wrong OTP attempts
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid mobile number 2. Enter wrong OTP 5 times consecutively
Expected Output: Account temporarily locked for 30 minutes

Objective/Summary: Verify OTP resend functionality works
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter mobile number 2. Request OTP 3. Click Resend OTP after 30 seconds
Expected Output: New OTP should be sent and old OTP should be invalidated

Objective/Summary: Verify login with unregistered mobile number
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter unregistered mobile number 2. Click Get OTP
Expected Output: Error: Number not registered should display

Objective/Summary: Verify OTP field rejects non-numeric characters
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter mobile number 2. Request OTP 3. Enter alphabets in OTP field
Expected Output: OTP field should only accept numeric digits

Objective/Summary: Verify session expires after inactivity
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Login successfully 2. Leave app idle for 15 minutes 3. Try any action
Expected Output: User should be prompted to re-login

Objective/Summary: Verify empty mobile number field shows validation error
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Leave mobile number field empty 2. Click Get OTP
Expected Output: Validation error: Please enter mobile number

Objective/Summary: Verify new user registration with valid details
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Open app 2. Click Register 3. Enter name, mobile, email 4. Set UPI PIN 5. Submit
Expected Output: Account created successfully

Objective/Summary: Verify registration fails with already registered number
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter already registered mobile number 2. Submit
Expected Output: Error: Mobile number already registered

Objective/Summary: Verify UPI PIN must be 4 or 6 digits during registration
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid user details 2. Try setting 3-digit UPI PIN
Expected Output: Error: PIN must be 4 or 6 digits

Objective/Summary: Verify email format validation during registration
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter invalid email format 2. Click Submit
Expected Output: Error: Enter valid email address

Objective/Summary: Verify successful payment to valid UPI ID
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Pay 2. Enter valid UPI ID 3. Enter amount 4. Enter UPI PIN 5. Confirm
Expected Output: Payment successful and amount deducted from balance

Objective/Summary: Verify payment to invalid UPI ID fails
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Pay 2. Enter invalid UPI ID 3. Enter amount 4. Click Pay
Expected Output: Error: Invalid UPI ID or user not found

Objective/Summary: Verify payment fails when balance is insufficient
Pre-requisite/Primary Condition: User should be logged in with low balance
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid UPI ID 2. Enter amount greater than balance 3. Enter PIN
Expected Output: Error: Insufficient balance message should display

Objective/Summary: Verify payment with zero amount is rejected
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid UPI ID 2. Enter 0 as amount 3. Click Pay
Expected Output: Error: Amount must be greater than zero

Objective/Summary: Verify payment with negative amount is rejected
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid UPI ID 2. Enter negative amount
Expected Output: Error: Invalid amount entered

Objective/Summary: Verify payment confirmation screen shows correct details
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter UPI ID and amount 2. Click Pay 3. Review confirmation screen
Expected Output: Confirmation screen should show correct payee name

Objective/Summary: Verify wrong UPI PIN blocks payment after 3 attempts
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid UPI ID and amount 2. Enter wrong PIN 3 times
Expected Output: Account should be blocked after 3 wrong PIN attempts

Objective/Summary: Verify payment failure due to network disconnection
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Start payment 2. Disconnect internet before confirmation
Expected Output: Retry or error message should display and amount should not be deducted

Objective/Summary: Verify duplicate payment is prevented on rapid taps
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Make a payment 2. Tap Pay button multiple times quickly
Expected Output: Payment should be processed only once

Objective/Summary: Verify receipt is generated after successful payment
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Make successful payment 2. Check for receipt
Expected Output: Digital receipt with transaction ID and timestamp should be generated

Objective/Summary: Verify payment timeout is handled gracefully
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Initiate payment 2. Wait for server timeout
Expected Output: Timeout message shown and amount not debited

Objective/Summary: Verify payment to self (same UPI ID) is blocked
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter own UPI ID as payee 2. Enter amount 3. Click Pay
Expected Output: Error: Cannot pay to your own UPI ID

Objective/Summary: Verify successful bank transfer with valid account and IFSC
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Transfer 2. Enter valid account number and IFSC 3. Enter amount 4. Confirm
Expected Output: Transfer should complete successfully

Objective/Summary: Verify transfer fails with invalid account number
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter invalid account number 2. Enter valid IFSC 3. Click Transfer
Expected Output: Error: Invalid account number

Objective/Summary: Verify transfer fails with invalid IFSC code
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid account number 2. Enter invalid IFSC 3. Click Transfer
Expected Output: Error: Invalid IFSC code

Objective/Summary: Verify transfer exceeding daily limit is blocked
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid account details 2. Enter amount above daily limit 3. Click Transfer
Expected Output: Warning: Daily transfer limit exceeded

Objective/Summary: Verify minimum transfer amount validation
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid account details 2. Enter amount Rs 0 3. Click Transfer
Expected Output: Error: Minimum transfer amount is Rs 1

Objective/Summary: Verify beneficiary name is shown after account verification
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid account number and IFSC 2. Click Verify
Expected Output: Account holder name should be displayed for confirmation

Objective/Summary: Verify transaction history is updated after successful transfer
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Complete a bank transfer 2. Go to Transaction History
Expected Output: Completed transfer should appear in history

Objective/Summary: Verify adding a new beneficiary with valid UPI ID
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Beneficiaries 2. Click Add New 3. Enter name and UPI ID 4. Save
Expected Output: Beneficiary added and visible in beneficiary list

Objective/Summary: Verify adding beneficiary with invalid UPI ID fails
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Add Beneficiary 2. Enter invalid UPI ID 3. Save
Expected Output: Error: Invalid UPI ID

Objective/Summary: Verify duplicate beneficiary cannot be added
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Add a beneficiary 2. Try adding same UPI ID again
Expected Output: Error: Beneficiary already exists

Objective/Summary: Verify beneficiary can be deleted
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Open Beneficiaries list 2. Select beneficiary 3. Click Delete 4. Confirm
Expected Output: Beneficiary should be removed from list

Objective/Summary: Verify payment to saved beneficiary works
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Select saved beneficiary 2. Enter amount 3. Enter UPI PIN 4. Confirm
Expected Output: Payment should be processed successfully

Objective/Summary: Verify successful payment by scanning valid QR code
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Scan QR 2. Scan valid merchant QR code 3. Enter amount 4. Enter PIN 5. Pay
Expected Output: Payment should complete and receipt generated

Objective/Summary: Verify error on scanning invalid or corrupted QR code
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Scan QR 2. Scan invalid QR code
Expected Output: Error: Invalid QR code - cannot process

Objective/Summary: Verify blurry QR code is not processed
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Scan QR 2. Hold blurry or low resolution QR code to scanner
Expected Output: Scanner should reject and prompt for clearer image

Objective/Summary: Verify QR code with pre-filled amount works correctly
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Scan QR with pre-filled amount 2. Review amount 3. Enter PIN 4. Pay
Expected Output: Pre-filled amount should display and payment should succeed

Objective/Summary: Verify user can generate personal QR code for receiving money
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Receive Money 2. Select Show QR Code 3. Enter optional amount
Expected Output: Personal QR code should be generated and displayed

Objective/Summary: Verify QR scan is blocked when camera permission denied
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Scan QR 2. Camera permission is denied
Expected Output: Error: Camera permission required to scan QR

Objective/Summary: Verify all completed transactions appear in history
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Transaction History 2. View list
Expected Output: All transactions shown with date

Objective/Summary: Verify transaction history filter by date range
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Transaction History 2. Apply date filter 3. View results
Expected Output: Only transactions within selected date range should display

Objective/Summary: Verify transaction history filter by type (Sent/Received/Failed)
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Transaction History 2. Filter by Sent
Expected Output: Only sent transactions should be displayed

Objective/Summary: Verify transaction detail view shows complete information
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Transaction History 2. Click any transaction
Expected Output: Transaction ID, date, time, amount, UPI ID and status should all be visible

Objective/Summary: Verify failed transactions are recorded in history
Pre-requisite/Primary Condition: User should have a failed transaction
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Perform a failed payment 2. Go to Transaction History
Expected Output: Failed transaction should appear with status as Failed

Objective/Summary: Verify empty state for new user with no transactions
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Register new account 2. Open Transaction History
Expected Output: Message: No transactions found should display

Objective/Summary: Verify transaction receipt can be downloaded or shared
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Open a transaction 2. Click Download or Share Receipt
Expected Output: Receipt should be downloadable as PDF or shareable via other apps

Objective/Summary: Verify account balance is displayed correctly on home screen
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Login 2. Go to Home screen
Expected Output: Current account balance should be shown accurately

Objective/Summary: Verify balance decreases after successful payment
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Note current balance 2. Make payment of Rs 500 3. Recheck balance
Expected Output: Balance should decrease by exactly Rs 500

Objective/Summary: Verify balance increases after receiving payment
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Receive payment of Rs 300 2. Check balance
Expected Output: Balance should increase by Rs 300

Objective/Summary: Verify bank account linking with valid details
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Link Bank Account 2. Select bank 3. Enter account details and verify
Expected Output: Bank account linked successfully

Objective/Summary: Verify bank account linking fails with incorrect details
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Link Bank Account 2. Enter wrong account number
Expected Output: Error: Could not verify bank account

Objective/Summary: Verify UPI PIN can be changed successfully
Pre-requisite/Primary Condition: User should be logged in and bank linked
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to UPI Settings 2. Select Change PIN 3. Enter old PIN 4. Enter new PIN 5. Confirm
Expected Output: PIN changed successfully and new PIN works for payments

Objective/Summary: Verify wrong old PIN blocks PIN change after 3 attempts
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Change PIN 2. Enter wrong old PIN 3 times
Expected Output: Account should be locked after 3 wrong attempts

Objective/Summary: Verify new PIN cannot be same as old PIN
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Change PIN 2. Enter old PIN as new PIN
Expected Output: Error: New PIN cannot be same as old PIN

Objective/Summary: Verify UPI PIN reset via bank debit card
Pre-requisite/Primary Condition: User should have linked debit card
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Forgot PIN 2. Enter debit card details 3. Set new PIN
Expected Output: PIN should be reset successfully

Objective/Summary: Verify PIN digits are masked for security
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to payment 2. Enter UPI PIN 3. Observe PIN entry field
Expected Output: PIN digits should be masked and not visible as plain text

Objective/Summary: Verify app locks after multiple failed login attempts
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enter valid mobile number 2. Enter wrong OTP 5 times
Expected Output: App access blocked for 30 minutes

Objective/Summary: Verify sensitive data hidden in app switcher
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Open payment screen 2. Press home button 3. Open recent apps
Expected Output: Account balance and UPI ID should be hidden or blurred in app preview

Objective/Summary: Verify fresh login required after app reinstall
Pre-requisite/Primary Condition: App should be installed and user logged in
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Uninstall app 2. Reinstall 3. Open app
Expected Output: User should not be auto logged in - fresh login required

Objective/Summary: Verify MPIN or biometric is required to open app
Pre-requisite/Primary Condition: Biometric or MPIN should be configured
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Close app completely 2. Reopen app
Expected Output: App should ask for MPIN or fingerprint or face ID before opening

Objective/Summary: Verify push notification received after successful payment
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Make a payment of Rs 200 2. Check notification tray
Expected Output: Push notification with transaction details should be received

Objective/Summary: Verify notification received when money is received
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Receive payment of Rs 500 from another user
Expected Output: Notification: You received Rs 500 should appear

Objective/Summary: Verify notification sent for failed transaction
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Initiate a payment that fails due to low balance
Expected Output: Notification: Transaction failed - amount not debited

Objective/Summary: Verify user profile details display correctly
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Profile section
Expected Output: Name, mobile number, email and UPI ID should be displayed

Objective/Summary: Verify user can update profile name and email
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Profile 2. Click Edit 3. Update name and email 4. Save
Expected Output: Profile should be updated and changes saved

Objective/Summary: Verify mobile number field is non-editable in profile
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Profile 2. Try to edit mobile number
Expected Output: Mobile number field should be locked and non-editable

Objective/Summary: Verify logout clears session completely
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Click Logout button 2. Confirm logout
Expected Output: User logged out and redirected to login screen with session cleared

Objective/Summary: Verify unauthorized access is blocked without login
Pre-requisite/Primary Condition: User should NOT be logged in
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Try to directly open dashboard or payment page
Expected Output: User should be redirected to login page

Objective/Summary: Verify account deactivation flow
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Go to Settings 2. Click Deactivate Account 3. Confirm deactivation
Expected Output: Account deactivated and user logged out

Objective/Summary: Verify app handles slow internet gracefully
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Enable slow network 2. Perform a payment
Expected Output: App should show loading indicators and not crash

Objective/Summary: Verify app shows proper message when no internet connection
Steps To Be Followed: 1. Turn off mobile data and WiFi 2. Open app and try any action
Expected Output: No internet connection message should display and app should not crash
